name: Specsavers / audiology corner
observations: Broad green fascia with white Specsavers emblems and optician/audiologist wording.
Lower glazed doors/displays framed in light colours; bright green advertising panels occupy some windows.
Upper red brick has a long row of light rectangular windows, with different internal blinds.
Corner has an open forecourt/pavement widening and short bollards near parked cars.
Low pitched roof and gutter form a continuous northbound retail row.
Brook/bridge is directly nearby; no infill building should seal that opening.
unknowns: Exact dimensions, rear elevation and interior layout are not established. Street View address is a camera label, not this unit address.
